items.title: What Is U.S. Bancorp (USB) Signaling With Its $240 Million Housing Fund?
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) launched a $240 million Low Income Housing Tax Credit fund to finance affordable housing projects. The new LIHTC vehicle nearly doubles the equity raised in U.S. Bank's inaugural affordable housing fund. Capital from the fund is earmarked to support 1,099 income restricted units across multiple U.S. states. items.title: 5 Banks With Dependable Passive Income Dividends That Could Prosper as Rates Rise
